verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that Authenticator has cloud backup, stored in a Microsoft personal account and iCloud on iOS. Nothing in the pack says those backups are end-to-end encrypted, that the key stays out of the vendor's hands, or that the encryption design is published. Backing up to a vendor account is not evidence of zero-knowledge encryption.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented
